description: Agent registry integration (Wave 1): Extend existing agent registry and coordinator to recognize and route 13 new migration repair agents, bringing total agent count from 15 to 28.
steps: Add 13 new AgentType enum values to app/orchestration/agent_registry.py: MIGRATION_AUDIT, DATABASE_SAFETY_AUDIT, TEST_INVENTORY, EVIDENCE_AUDIT, REPAIR_PLANNER, REPAIR_REVIEWER, REPAIR_IMPLEMENTER, STATIC_REVIEWER, TEST_REVIEWER, VERIFICATION_RUNNER, EVIDENCE_ASSEMBLER, FINAL_GATE_AGENT, PUBLISHER_AGENT

Add 13 Agent definitions in _initialize_agents() method with capabilities for each agent following the pattern: migration_audit has [scan_migration_files, verify_journal_consistency, detect_duplicate_objects, check_dependency_order]
Update app/orchestration/agent_coordinator.py _execute_agent_capabilities() to add dispatch branches for each new agent type, importing from app.workflows.migration_repair.agents.{agent_name}
Update tests/test_agent_registry.py: change assertion from 15 to 28 agents in test_all_15_agents_registered() and test_agent_types_enum_complete()
Add test_migration_repair_agents_registered() to verify all 13 new agents exist and have non-empty capabilities
acceptance_criteria: AgentType enum contains exactly 28 values (15 existing + 13 new)
